PRIVACY

Your date calculations stay in your browser.

Last updated: 12 September 2026

Calculations

DayFinder performs calculator operations on your device. Dates entered into the tools are not intentionally transmitted to or stored by DayFinder.

Local preferences

Your language choice and offline files may be stored by your browser using local storage and service-worker caching. You can remove them through your browser settings.

Hosting logs

The hosting provider may process standard technical request information, such as IP address, browser type and requested page, for security and service operation.

Analytics and advertising

This version does not declare an analytics or advertising integration. If either is added later, this notice and any required consent controls should be updated before activation.

External links

Links to Avyuha or other websites are governed by those websites’ own privacy practices.

Important note

Do not rely on DayFinder as the sole source for legal, payroll, banking, medical or official decisions. Confirm critical dates with the appropriate authority.
